 IonQ Names Gary Merrill CFO and Thomas Austin Chief Accounting Officer as Inder Singh Departs
 November 13, 2026 
 Gary Merrill and Thomas A. Austin 
 IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), a College Park, Maryland-based quantum computing company, has appointed Gary Merrill as Chief Financial Officer and Thomas A. Austin as Chief Accounting Officer, strengthening its financial leadership as the company expands its quantum technology operations and pursues long-term profitability.
 Merrill, currently Chief Financial Officer of Commvault Systems (NASDAQ: CVLT), will join IonQ in early December 2026. Austin, formerly Chief Accounting Officer at Juniper Networks, has assumed the newly created Chief Accounting Officer position effective immediately.
 The appointments coincide with the departure of Inder M. Singh, who is stepping down from his roles at IonQ effective immediately.
 The leadership changes come as IonQ expands beyond quantum computing into an integrated technology platform encompassing quantum networking, sensing and security.
 “Gary and Tom bring extensive public company experience across finance and accounting that will be increasingly important as IonQ continues to scale and hone its long-term path to profitability,” said Niccolo de Masi , Chairman and CEO of IonQ.
 De Masi also thanked Singh for his contributions, noting his involvement with the company both as a board member and as part of its management team.
 Merrill brings approximately two decades of executive leadership experience spanning corporate finance, business operations and commercial strategy.
 At Commvault, he has held several senior leadership positions, including Chief Financial Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, Chief Business Operations Officer and Chief Accounting Officer.
 He most recently returned to the CFO position in April 2026 after serving as Commvault’s Chief Commercial Officer from 2024 to 2026.
 During his tenure as Chief Commercial Officer, Merrill oversaw the company’s global sales and partner organizations, supporting double-digit annual recurring revenue growth and expansion of its software-as-a-service business.
 Previously, as CFO from 2022 to 2024, he helped oversee Commvault’s transition toward a subscription-based business model, strengthened financial operations and managed relationships with investors.
 Merrill began his career as a Certified Public Accountant at Arthur Andersen and holds a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Elizabethtown College.
 “IonQ’s robust balance sheet is a distinct advantage in the quantum industry, giving the company the strength to accelerate its technical and commercial leadership,” Merrill said. “I look forward to partnering with Niccolo, the leadership team and the finance organization to drive strong execution and long-term value creation for IonQ and its shareholders.”
 Austin brings more than 30 years of experience in corporate accounting, financial reporting and regulatory compliance.
 Most recently, he served as Chief Accounting Officer at Juniper Networks, now part of Hewlett Packard Enterprise, where he spent six years overseeing accounting operations, regulatory compliance, internal controls, Securities and Exchange Commission reporting and global shared services.
 Before Juniper, Austin spent 11 years at EMC Corporation and Dell Technologies, including serving as Vice President of Corporate Finance.
 In that position, he led a global organization responsible for financial reporting and disclosures involving revenue and cost-of-sales operations.
 Earlier in his career, Austin served for seven years as Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of Arbor Networks.
 He began his professional career as a Certified Public Accountant at Coopers & Lybrand, now part of PwC.
 Austin holds an MBA from Babson College’s Olin Graduate School of Business and a bachelor’s degree in Public Accounting from Providence College, where he has also served on the Business School Advisory Council and as an Adjunct Professor of Finance.
 The creation of the Chief Accounting Officer position adds a dedicated senior executive responsible for accounting and financial reporting as IonQ manages an increasingly complex global business.
 IonQ develops quantum computing systems and related technologies for applications including drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity and defense.
 Its quantum technology portfolio includes computing, networking, sensing and security products, with services available through major cloud providers since 2021.
 The company has expanded its international operations across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific.
 IonQ’s latest quantum computing system, Superion, is part of its effort to improve quantum processing capabilities and expand commercial applications.
 The company reported achieving 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity in 2025, a performance milestone it characterized as a world record.
 The appointments of Merrill and Austin bring additional public-company financial management experience to IonQ as it seeks to balance continued investment in quantum technology with financial discipline and its longer-term profitability objectives.
